title: Build the canonical Home
acceptance: Exactly one primary action; at most 7 visible targets on desktop and 5 on phone, not counting legal links.
No text streams on Home and no sound plays before a press.
All five rooms are reachable in 1 click on desktop and 2 taps on phone.
Continue appears if and only if a reading can be resumed, and is then the primary action.
Criterion 4 (R2) is held by RDR-015 and FND-010
